info.description: A studio article shown on the Blog. Title, slug, SEO fields, and the author relation are set here; the frontend renders everything from the CMS with no code changes.

title.description: Headline — used in the URL slug and as the default SEO title.

slug.description: URL slug, e.g. "how-we-approach-ai-chatbot-projects". Change it before publishing — the blog routes on this.

excerpt.description: Card teaser shown on the Blog listing.

coverImage.description: Card and article cover. Also used as the og:image for social sharing.

body.description: The article itself — headings, paragraphs, lists.

author.description: The team member who wrote this post. Shown in the byline, linked to the About page.

category.description: Grouping shown on the Blog listing filter.

seoTitle.description: Optional — overrides the page title in browsers and search results.

seoDescription.description: Optional — used for the meta description and social share text. Falls back to the excerpt.
